mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate applied to future cash flows, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS has risen by ≥0.25pp over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 315.0 signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 315.0, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 700,000 million dollars) signals an overheating economy that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0 and RSAFS > 700000, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1350 thousand units signals weakening demand and impending economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of instances when HOUST < 1350 during late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months signals strong labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in >60% of instances when PAYEMS has increased by at least 100,000 over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 102.0 signals a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 102.0, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS increased by ≥0.25pp over 3 months) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals aggressive monetary tightening in a tight labor market, which reduces equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with monetary tightening
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS has risen by ≥0.25pp and UNRATE < 4.0, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) below 2.0% annualized signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in >60% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate < 2.0% annualized during late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
